title: Customer and Trading Manager – Online
summary: Lead the online picking and delivery operation at Sainsbury's Cromwell Road store. You will organise early-morning activity, coach a large team of shoppers and drivers, monitor customer and operational targets, and coordinate with other store managers. The role also includes scheduling, performance management, employee relations, and responsibility for safe, reliable customer service.
responsibilities: Plan the work of the online picking and delivery team
Coach shoppers and drivers to deliver safe customer service
Manage performance, scheduling, pay, and employee relations
Work with other managers to keep the wider store running smoothly
required_qualifications: Line management in a fast-paced operational environment
